delta-tree.limit: The plan shows four columns and the stern drawing two. Retained three rows of four. Side centers sit 9 to 16 grid pixels below the elevation marks. Two of nine pale painting marks hit dark fittings. The outboard amber points were fitting targets.

registration: Both painting cameras, review cameras and exposures are inherited from round 193. Paintings are 1024 square. Gallery renders add 64 pixels per side. The 3504 × 2336 sheet traces use a 1440 × 960 grid. Orthographic checks use independent length calibration in each view.
lighting: Local Blender 5.2.0 LTS, Cycles, 24 samples. Main studio, key rotated 65 degrees, and emitters-only control. The original lighting and exposure are unknown.
appearance_method: Means from opaque five-by-five display-referred RGB patches in each fixed gallery. Brightness uses Rec.709 weights on the 8-bit display values. The record identifies marks touching transparent background in each revision. Original and selected counts match for Glacier and Delta’s two main finishes. Only two of three revised amber patches are fully opaque. These patch averages describe marked finishes under this studio.
scope: Rotatable local exterior review. The Windows duel uses round 172.
record_note: The first Delta run rendered and saved both model formats, then its measurement writer failed to serialize a numeric scalar. The two revised Delta runs wrote complete fit records.

delivery.viewer: Both models rotate, reset, switch revision and download in isolated headless Chrome.
delivery.paseo_workspace: The existing workspace report tab displayed round 198, both ship summaries and the comparison thread.
